searchText: <@!489256758989029405> did you get a chance to implement the latest base fee computation and test it against the testnet ? yep, all synced good, tomorrow i will start working on the other changes from the latest specification: removal of the transition period and the single transaction pool Should we then merge <@!301186049323958275>'s single txn pool PR so the EIP is up to date with the implementations? > Should we then merge <@!301186049323958275>'s single txn pool PR so the EIP is up to date with the implementations? <@!552133098075193354> Yes IMO You're an EIP author now, <@!574864862338088960>, I think you can do it 😄 > You're an EIP author now, <@!574864862338088960>, I think you can do it 😄 <@!552133098075193354> i don't have write access to the repo <@!301186049323958275> as an EIP editor, do you know why that is? I don't think we can be sure miners will make less $ after 1559; it seems to me they'll make more dollars (less Eth).
